_doc: Built-in defaults for framework/core/site_registry.py: the sites this deployment serves today. Schema: shared/schemas/sites-registry.schema.json. It lives under shared/ because the dashboard API image copies only framework/ and shared/.

A framework-storage copy at config/sites-registry.json (exactly that key) is merged over this file BY SITE NAME (fields replace, null resets to the derived default, objects deep-merge, lists replace); a site this file does not define is appended, and by default is walked after every site here (dispatch_group one higher). replace_sites=true in the storage copy drops these entries. The result must keep at least one enabled site.
No two sites may share a domain, repo_path, seo_site_yaml file or DSN env var (dsn_env and dsn_env_aliases together), disabled sites included.

Every value here reproduces what the consumers enumerate in code today (backlog-dispatcher PRODUCER_AGENT_IDS and _site_from_agent_id, priority.py _STARVATION_SITES and tiers 2/3, implementation_queue's subject-tag heuristic, implementer run.sh's examples/sites/<site>.yaml and DATABASE_URL_<SITE> lookups, goals-tracker SITE_TRACKERS, the DSN maps). framework/tests/test_site_registry.py reads those consumers' source and fails if this file drifts from them.

dsn_env_aliases lists the other env var names consumers read for the same DSN: reconcile-shipped tries DATABASE_URL_<SITE> then <SITE>_DSN; the metrics collector and the indexnow/GSC sites.json read only <SITE>_DATABASE_URL. A consumer that reads one convention passes names=[...] to dsn_for().
